blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Traffic Enforcement Agency of Mandaue (TEAM) has hired 21 new personnel to fill vacancies following the termination of 18 job order workers who tested positive for illegal drug use last month. TEAM head Hyll Retuya, in an interview on Tuesday, Nov. 10, said the newly hired personnel had already started reporting for work and had been deployed across Mandaue City since November 1. Retuya said the hiring was conducted to replace personnel who were dismissed following the implementation of random drug testing among traffic enforcers.
